The '''Void Wings''' were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] period. The Void Wings were formed prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], when an earlier pirate organization was disbanded and split in two groups: the [[Night Fangs]] and the Void Wings.<ref name="P&P" />

In space battles, Void Wings pilots flew [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s, [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]]s, [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]] and [[Warlord Heavy Cruiser]]s. One such cruiser was the ''[[Fear and Futility]]''.<ref name="SWG:VWPQP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Void Wing Pilot Quota Progress}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Void Wings appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Contrary to other space factions that were introduced with the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']],<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> the Void Wings were added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|Chapter 8]],"<ref name="SWG:VWPQP" /> on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="C8">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref> With this update, several space-based kill collections were added to the game and Void Wings starfighters, transports and gunships were added to various star systems.<ref name="SWG:C8" /> Later, the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," released on [[March 23]], [[2010]],<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref> allowed players to fight unlimited waves of Void Wings vessels spawned from the [[Dantooine Space Station|Dantooine]], [[Naboo Space Station|Naboo]] and [[Yavin 4 Space Station|Yavin space stations]].<ref name="SWG:GU16" />

In the game, Void Wings pilots incorrectly used the same models and taunt sentences than the [[Dark Veil Order]] pilots, erroneously mentioning their cult of the [[Heart of Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:TCOA" />
